title: epoch.to_bytes raises OverflowError for negative or large values
description:
epoch.to_bytes(4, 'little') raises OverflowError if epoch < 0 or epoch >= 2^32. No validation or documentation of valid range. Same issue at line 198. Unlikely in practice since epochs are typically unix timestamps within u32 range, but unhandled exception is unexpected behavior.

File: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py
Line: 55
